name: Skillet Sausage & Zucchini
desc: Sliced precooked sausage browned and tossed with zucchini, onion, bell pepper, dried herbs, and garlic in one skillet.

source.title: 20 Minute Sausage and Zucchini Skillet
source.evidence: Same 2 1/2 tbsp oil, 4 cooked sausages, 2 zucchini and 1 tsp garlic; supplies the six seasoning amounts.

ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 tbsp olive or avocado oil, divided
4 fully cooked sausage links (about 12 oz, such as chicken or smoked pork), sliced 1/4 inch thick
ingredients.note: about 12 oz, such as chicken or smoked pork

ingredients.raw: 1 medium yellow onion, cut into 3/4-inch pieces
1 medium bell pepper (any color), cut into 3/4-inch pieces

steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sausage and cook, flipping often, until the slices have some browning, 1-2 min. Move to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the remaining 1 1/2 tbsp oil, the zucchini, onion, and bell pepper. Sprinkle with the salt, oregano, dried basil, garlic powder, onion powder, and pepper and stir.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent and the zucchini and pepper are close to tender, 5-10 min.
Return the sausage to the skillet with the minced garlic, stir, cover, and cook until heated through, 1-2 min. Taste for salt and serve scattered with fresh basil.
tips: Cut the vegetables to about the size of the zucchini cubes so everything finishes cooking at the same time.
